name: GoliathCrop
tagline: Crop management on GoliathApp: fields, operations, sensors, imagery, trials, and yield.
description: GoliathCrop specializes GoliathApp for commercial farms and research stations. Phase 5 completes the planned roadmap with CPU baseline yield prediction (RunPod-ready workers), GoliathOmics/GroundStation integration hooks, and ISOBUS/ADAPT import stubs. Earlier phases deliver PostGIS core data, sensing, irrigation, scouting, and portal domain views.

features.title: Fields, seasons, and operations
features.description: PostGIS field and plot geometry, plantings by season, and a log of irrigation, fertilization, spraying, and harvest with inputs inventory.

features.title: Sensors, weather, and imagery
features.description: TimescaleDB sensor readings, free weather providers (Open-Meteo, NOAA), and Sentinel-2/Landsat NDVI stored as COGs.

features.title: Yield forecast and ecosystem links
features.description: Season yield reads, CPU baseline predictions, optional RunPod GPU workers, omics and ground-station registration actions.

features.title: DomainPrograms with dual activation
features.description: Backlog work is claimed through goliath-gateway; event-triggered work wakes workers via Postgres pub/sub.
